name: demo-contract-rules
description: Project-contract rules for the stage 080 migrations (MTA 8.2 custom-rules guide): surfaces the analysis cannot know from stock rules — env-driven external integrations (the preserve: contract), user-facing surfaces (the ui-surface plan requirement), and in-memory state (cloud readiness). Labeled target=quarkus so they fire whenever our analyses select that target (reserved-label requirement, ch. 8.1).

demo-env-integration-00001.description: Environment-driven external configuration must be preserved

incidents.message: This configuration key follows the environment-variable convention (ALL_CAPS key or ${ALL_CAPS} placeholder) — an operational contract: deployments inject it to point the app at external services. Record it under `preserve:` in migration.yaml and keep it env-driven in the migrated configuration (e.g. `quarkus.rest-client.<key>.url=${VAR:default}`). Erasing or hardcoding it is a functional regression no unit test catches.

demo-inmemory-state-00001.description: In-memory collection state in a service — verify cloud readiness

incidents.message: A service holds state in an in-memory map. On OpenShift this state is lost on every pod restart and diverges across replicas. Confirm this is acceptable for the service's contract (and record the decision in the spec) or plan externalization; do not silently carry it through the migration.

incidents.message:
Use the Maven Failsafe plugin adding the following sections to the `pom.xml` file: 

 ```xml
 <properties> 
 <surefire-plugin.version>3.0.0</compiler-plugin.version>
 </properties> 
 <build>
 <plugins>
 <plugin>
 <artifactId>maven-failsafe-plugin</artifactId>
 <version>${surefire-plugin.version}</version>
 <executions>
 <execution>
 <goals>
 <goals>integration-test</goal>
 <goals>verify</goal>
 </goals>
 <configuration>
 <systemPropertyVariables>
 <native.image.path>${project.build.directory}/${project.build.finalName}-runner</native.image.path>
 <java.util.logging.manager>org.jboss.logmanager.LogManager</java.util.logging.manager>
 <maven.home>${maven.home}</maven.home>
 </systemPropertyVariables>
 </configuration>
 </execution>
 </executions>
 </plugin>
 </plugins>
 </build>
 ```

javaee-pom-to-quarkus-00060.description: Add Maven profile to run the Quarkus native build

incidents.message:
Leverage a Maven profile to run the Quarkus native build adding the following section to the `pom.xml` file: 

 ```xml
 <profiles>
 <profile>
 <id>native</id>
 <activation>
 <property>
 <name>native</name>
 </property>
 </activation>
 <properties>
 <skipITs>false</skipITs>
 <quarkus.package.type>native</quarkus.package.type>
 </properties>
 </profile>
 </profiles>
 ```
